text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired PD-38421: inference-queue.depth > 1000 for 6m; backlog growth rate high; autoscaler not keeping up.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page sent to #eng-oncall primary=ben_oncall, escalation=carla_sre

ben_oncall: acked — I'm looking.

ben_oncall: seeing repeated errors in scale-controller: "failed to create nodepool: quota exceeded"

carla_sre: confirmed. Cloud GPU quota for prod-us-east exhausted (requested 12, available 0).

alice.ops: are we seeing customer impact yet? any 5xx/504 spikes?

tilly_support: yea, support queue: several customers reporting elevated latency and some 504s on /v1/generate. Not widespread but impacting high-throughput tenants.

mike_infra: propose manual spin-up of emergency reserve pool and temporary routing to it. I'm executing playbook step 2 now.

mike_infra: running provisioning script:
```
./infra/provision_reserved_pool.sh --region us-east-1 --gpu a100 --count 6 --tag pd-emergency
```

ben_oncall: provisioning started (request id req-02b9). ETA ~6m. kicking off shorter-term throttles too.

carla_sre: also lowering max_batch_size for streaming routes to 8 to reduce per-request queueing, will patch config in rollout.

alice.ops: I'll draft an incident note for affected customers (top 5) — short status + ETA.

pagerduty: PD escalation: primary acknowledged by ben_oncall, secondary carla_sre notified.

ben_oncall: provisioning progress: 4/6 nodes active and joining cluster. autoscaler still reporting scale-loop errors but nodes present.

mike_infra: forcing adoption:
```
kubectl -n infra-scale annotate node node-ephemeral-01 scalable=true
kubectl -n infra-scale rollout restart deployment/scale-controller
```

carla_sre: rollout complete. scale-controller logs show successful handshake with new nodes. backlog drain rate improving (~40% reduction in pending requests over 4m).

tilly_support: support: customers reporting fewer 504s, but a handful still see elevated latency. continue monitoring.

ben_oncall: mitigation checklist done: emergency pool created (pd-emergency), batch-size temporarily reduced, scale-controller restarted. monitoring queue depth and p50/p95 latency.

alice.ops: incident channel created for timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-38421. I'll post customer note and update top-of-page.

ben_oncall: handing off monitoring and followups to night oncall @maria_noc in 20m. leaving runbook notes + commands executed. assigning postmortem to eng-runtime.

mike_infra: note — file a quota increase request with cloud support; current workaround uses reserved pool tag 'pd-emergency' but it's temporary.

carla_sre: agree. also plan to re-enable original batching config gradually once backlog < 200 and sustained for 10m.

incident-bot: Incident PD-38421 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring (runbook: inference-queue-flood). :white_check_mark:

ben_oncall: marking as mitigated for now. will keep eyes on it for 30m then close if stable. great teamwork. :thumbsup:
